# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting internet culture phenomena and scientific content, primarily from Know Your Meme's viral meme database and Scientific American's science journalism.

This site aggregates content from Know Your Meme (internet culture encyclopedia documenting viral trends, memes, and social media phenomena primarily from TikTok, Twitter/X, and DeviantArt) and Scientific American (science journalism and subscription services). The content spans meme explainers, trending social media content, and scientific publications.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Internet memes and image macros
- Know Your Meme documentation
- Exploitable memes
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, DeviantArt, Facebook)
- Viral catchphrases and dance trends
- Pop culture references (Breaking Bad, 90s hood movies)
- Mental health humor
- Scientific American journalism
- Content creators (BunnaB, YKNiece, Phillip Hamilton)
- Nostalgia-driven content
- Hood saxophone meme trend
- ICE detention viral stories

- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide explaining viral Nasra Ahmed ICE detention memes from Minneapolis

## Viral Meme Entries

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme from DeviantArt featuring heartbreaking cat imagery
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB and YKNiece's rap song 'Innit'
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White and Jesse Pinkman

- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Collection of relatable mental health and depression humor memes
